text:
maya: CI is red on PR #6289 — image build succeeded but push failed in the final step. buildkit output shows a checksum mismatch for a pushed layer :confused:

maya: example from the job log:
```
Pushing layer sha256:4c2a7f...
Error: registry responded with 400 Bad Request: invalid layer checksum
```

ryan: ugh. did we change the Dockerfile or multistage ordering in that PR? checksum mismatches usually mean either corrupted upload or the registry rejected the digest.

julia: PR did reorder a couple COPY steps to optimize cache, but nothing that should change blob contents for that layer. last green was 2 commits ago on main.

alex: can we rule out CI-side transient corruption? can someone rerun with no cache (kaniko --cache=false) to see if it reproduces?

maya: ran a manual rebuild locally with docker build + docker push to our staging registry — it pushed fine. CI uses kaniko in k8s.

ci-bot: Build #4821 (pr-6289) finished with status FAILED. Failure step: push-image. See: https://ci.internal/reports/4821

ryan: maybe the kaniko cache on the worker node is corrupt. we've seen ephemeral PVCs hang around. @julia can you check the node that ran the job (node-12)? 

julia: checking node-12 logs now. Also seeing some 5xxs from registry gateway in the same timespan. pinging registry-bot.

registry-bot: Incident FYI — registry-gateway experienced intermittent 500 errors between 2026-02-16T18:03 and 18:12 UTC due to a backend checksum verification bug. Root cause being investigated.

alex: that would explain it. If registry returned a 500 mid-upload, kaniko might have retried and ended up with inconsistent state.

maya: so what are action items — do we rerun CI, or force a full rebuild?

ryan: try a rerun first. if it fails again, run with --cache=false and/or clean the kaniko PVC. also consider pinning kaniko image to the newer patch we rolled last week — there was a fix for retry behavior.

julia: triggered a rerun: /ci retry 4821 — job queued.

ci-bot: Build #4821 (pr-6289) rerun started.

maya: thanks. if rerun succeeds we can chalk it up to registry transient. if it fails, i'll add a commit to the PR that forces no-cache and we can bisect between kaniko versions.

ryan: if we see this happen more than once in the next 24 hours, ops should evict kaniko pods on node-12 and rotate the PVCs.

julia: rerun completed — BUILD SUCCESS and image pushed. :tada:

maya: awesome. leaving issue open to follow up with registry team on the 500 window. also adding a short note to the CI runbook about re-running and using --cache=false when the registry reports 5xx during push.

alex: recommend we also add automated retry logic in the push step that invalidates local cache on repeated 5xxs. filing a small RFC.

maya: filing follow-up ticket: INFRA-1724 (investigate registry 500 & kaniko retries). linking the CI log in the ticket.

maya: thanks everyone :heart:
